product_updates.content: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

product_updates.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
product_updates.content: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

product_updates.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
product_updates.content: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

product_updates.title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
product_updates.content: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.
